queries.q: Why was Antonia walking to Russian Peter's house?

span.text: TO BORROW A SPADE AMBROSCH NEEDED

required_facts.description: Antonia was going to borrow a spade that Ambrosch needed.

queries.q: Why did he travel to a distant city on a particular day every year?

span.text: TO COLLECT MONEY ON AN ACCOUNT

required_facts.description: The annual trip was to collect money on an account.

queries.q: What meeting was he going to try to persuade Catherine to allow?

span.text: PERSUADING CATHERINE TO GRANT SYDNEY AN INTERVIEW

required_facts.description: He would try to persuade Catherine to give Sydney an interview.

queries.q: Which flowers should the woman have been holding up to his face?

span.text: HER HANDS SHOULD HAVE BEEN FULL OF BLUEBELLS

required_facts.description: The imagined flowers in her hands were bluebells.

queries.q: What conflicting feelings did Colonel Leonidas Talbot have about the white flag?

span.text: TRIUMPH AND SADNESS WERE MINGLED STRANGELY

required_facts.description: Talbot felt both triumph and sadness.

queries.q: What precaution did the guide require before the signal to pull him up?

span.text: FASTEN HIM SECURELY TO THE LOOP BEFORE YOU GIVE THE SIGNAL TO HAUL UP

required_facts.description: He had to be securely fastened to the loop before the hauling signal.

queries.q: Whose palace did the guide say the little stone building was?

span.text: THE PALACE OF TOURMALINE WHO IS OUR QUEEN

required_facts.description: The little stone building was the palace of Queen Tourmaline.

queries.q: Who was Deucalion's father in the ancient story?

span.text: HE WAS THE SON OF PROMETHEUS

required_facts.description: Deucalion was the son of Prometheus.

queries.q: What is the yellow grain sold by grocers for making puddings called?

span.text: A YELLOW VARIETY CALLED GOLDEN MILLET

required_facts.description: The yellow pudding grain was called golden millet.

queries.q: What sound did the thousands of birds answer with their songs?

span.text: THOUSANDS OF BIRDS ANSWERED THE MUSIC OF FOUNTAINS WITH THEIR SONGS

required_facts.description: The birds answered the music of fountains.

queries.q: For what alleged offense had the former bank clerk been transported?

span.text: WAS TRANSPORTED FOR EMBEZZLEMENT

required_facts.description: The former clerk was transported for embezzlement, although some doubted his guilt.

queries.q: Where was the first act's cabin scene supposed to take place?

span.text: THE INTERIOR OF A CABIN IN THE SOUTH OF IRELAND

required_facts.description: The first act was set inside a cabin in southern Ireland.

queries.q: How many months did the discovered Martian calendar divide the year into?

span.text: THE YEAR HAD BEEN DIVIDED INTO TEN MORE OR LESS EQUAL MONTHS

required_facts.description: The Martian year had ten approximately equal months.

queries.q: Who was going to make all the arrangements for the narrator's wedding?

span.text: ALL THE ARRANGEMENTS FOR MY WEDDING ARE GOING TO BE MADE BY THE SNELLINGS

required_facts.description: The Snellings were going to arrange the wedding.

queries.q: What was the practical joke played on the physicians?

span.text: SENT HALF DRESSED TO SOME NOBLEMAN WHO WAS ENJOYING EXCELLENT HEALTH

required_facts.description: The physicians were sent half dressed to a nobleman who was actually healthy.

queries.q: Why could the traveler choose to leave the blanket behind?

span.text: WOOD FOR FIRES IS EVERYWHERE ABUNDANT

required_facts.description: Abundant firewood made it possible to do without the blanket.

queries.q: Where was the Gwynplaine the Laughing Man placard hung after removal from the green box?

span.text: WAS HUNG UP CLOSE TO THE SIGN OF THE INN

required_facts.description: The placard was hung beside the inn's sign.

queries.q: What was painted on the house signboards that made the traveler feel at home?

span.text: WAS PAINTED A BOTTLE AND A GLASS

required_facts.description: The signboards depicted a bottle and a glass.

queries.q: Where had Lady Milborough wanted him to take his wife?

span.text: TAKEN HER OFF WITH HIM TO NAPLES

required_facts.description: Lady Milborough wanted him to return to his wife and take her to Naples.

queries.q: Where did Thompson open the restaurant praised for its cooking and service?

span.text: IN O'FARRELL STREET JUST ABOVE FILLMORE

required_facts.description: Thompson's restaurant was on O'Farrell Street just above Fillmore.
